---
title: '20260731'
version: 0.74.0
date: 2026-07-31
description: Added session forking, a redesigned right sidebar with Browser and Side Chat, configurable dynamic sessions, and archive search and sorting.
---
### ✨ New

- Added session forking. Use the Fork button below an Agent reply to branch a session from that reply; Codex and Claude Code also support forking from any point in the session.
- Redesigned the right sidebar and added Browser and Side Chat.
- Browser can open any URL for local sessions. For remote sessions, it can access ports on the machine running the session. Agent control of Browser is not supported yet.
- Dynamically created Lody sessions can now be configured during the chat, including model and reasoning effort.
- Added search and sorting to archived sessions.

### 🐛 Fixes and Improvements

- Updated light mode to use a true white background.
- Refined parts of the mobile UI.
- Fixed the mobile keyboard occasionally remaining open after sending a message.
- Fixed sessions that could fail to sync in local-first mode.
- Fixed the project list in the new-session flow not scrolling far enough to show all projects.
- Reduced CLI CPU and memory usage.
- Improved machine online-status stability.
- Refined session search to search only message content, excluding tool calls and their results.
